Shaant logon ke dimaag shor karte hain.
Nadi chattan ko shakti se nahi, balki apni nirantar mehnat se kaat ti hai.
Silence sabse badi izzat hai.
Sabr aur himmat hi asli taj hai.
Kabhi kabhi silence consent hota hai.
Grit direction ke saath patience hai.
Himmat dard ke saath khadi rehti hai.
Sahas sabse zaroori gun hai; bina iske koi bhi dusra gun lagataar nahi nibhaya ja sakta.
Sahas dar ka virodh hai, dar ki kami nahi.
Grit believe karta: aap kar sakte.
Khamoshi aaram hai.
Himmat ek manspeshi hai.
Himmat phir se khade hona hai.
Bravery darr ke saath move karna hai.
Grit mushkil cheezein lagatar karna.
Grit buniyad hai.
Jo apne aap ko jeet leta hai, wahi sabse powerful warrior hai.
Khud par quit karne se inkaar—grit.
Sachi himmat kaam bolti hai.
Sabse strong jawab restraint hai.
